description: This Java source file defines the utility class HexUtil, which provides static methods for converting between byte arrays and hexadecimal strings, as well as parsing hex strings to bytes and integers. It is a utility class used for handling hexadecimal data representations within the project.

classes.name: HexUtil
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods for hexadecimal and byte array conversions, parsing, and formatting.

methods.name: asHex
methods.description: Converts a byte or byte array to its uppercase hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: asBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a byte array, handling optional '0x' prefix and spaces.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array (or a segment of it) to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: bytesToHexAppend
methods.description: Appends hexadecimal representation of a byte segment to an existing StringBuffer.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a byte array.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a byte array with specified offset.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Populates a provided byte array with data parsed from a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: hexToInt
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string into an integer, handling optional '0x' prefix.

methods.name: intToHexString
methods.description: Converts an integer to its hexadecimal string representation prefixed with '0x'.
